remaining: Site-renderer issue across the corpus, not this paper: scripts/problems-to-site.mjs suppresses the <figure>/<figcaption> block for any figure embedded inline as ![alt](url), so the verbatim printed caption in figures[].caption is never shown. Here that hides the printed instruction on p3-fig2 ('Не правете измервания по това изображение, а по големите изображения... Намерете посочените тук звезди A,B,C,D...'). Same shape exists in the already-promoted nao-2023-ii-9-10.json. Needs a corpus-level decision (render figcaption even for inline figures, or make inline alt == caption).

Editorial (documented in transcription.notes, no content lost): three blocks were moved relative to the printed layout — the 'Представете си...' lead paragraph into part 2 В), the unlabelled 'Предоставени са ви две изображения... Определете мащаба...' block kept at the end of 3 А), and problem 4's 'Приемете, че всички орбити са кръгови...' plus Справочни данни hoisted from after В) into the problem preamble. Worth a human confirming this is the house convention.
